claims.claim: Hosted Low Profile keeps merchants in SAQ-A scope; direct server-to-server Transaction with raw CardNumber/CVV2 falls under SAQ-D.
claims.raw_snippet: Self-Assessment Questionnaire (SAQ) A includes only those PCI DSS requirements applicable to merchants with account data functions completely outsourced to PCI DSS validated and compliant third parties, where the merchant retains only paper reports or receipts with account data.
claims.source_note: SAQ A eligibility turns on complete outsourcing of account-data functions, which is what hosted Low Profile achieves. Split from a previously stitched quote; the second half is now claim 13.1.

claims.claim: SAQ A merchants must not store, process, or transmit account data in electronic format on their own systems, which is what a server-to-server Transaction call carrying raw CardNumber/CVV2 does.
claims.raw_snippet: SAQ A merchants may be either e-commerce or mail/telephone-order merchants (card-not-present) and do not store, process, or transmit any account data in electronic format on their systems or premises.
claims.source_note: Second contiguous paragraph of the SAQ A eligibility criteria, split out of the former stitched quote on claim 13.

claims.claim: Cardcom publishes three settlement cycles: monthly (1st to day-before-month-end, credited the 6th of the following month), weekly (Sun-Fri, credited the following Wednesday), and bi-monthly (1st-15th credited the 2nd; 16th-month-end credited the 8th). Configured per terminal, not via API.
claims.raw_snippet: זיכוי חודשי: עסקאות שבוצעו מה-1 לחודש ועד יום לפני סוף החודש - ב-6 לחודש העוקב זיכוי שבועי: עסקאות שבוצעו מיום ראשון עד יום שישי - ביום רביעי בשבוע שאחרי* זיכוי דו-חודשי: עסקאות מה-1 עד ה-15 לחודש - ב-2 לחודש העוקב; עסקאות מה-16 ועד יום לפני סוף החודש - ב-8
claims.source_note: Resolves the 2.2.0 carry item that softened settlement days for lack of a source. Reached via https://www.cardcom.solutions/עמלת-סליקה-לעסקים/ which 301s here.

claims.claim: Cardcom publishes a starting clearing fee of about 1.2% that decreases with transaction volume. This is an advertised floor, not a quote.

claims.source_note: Resolves the 2.2.0 carry item on pricing. Deliberately recorded as a floor; the skill still routes users to Cardcom for an actual quote.

claims.claim: Cardcom's invoicing system is connected directly by API to the Tax Authority computers, so when a document is issued at an amount that requires an allocation number the system requests it automatically and stamps it on the invoice.
claims.raw_snippet: מערכת החשבוניות של קארדקום מחוברת ישירות (ב-API) למחשבי רשות המיסים. ברגע שאתם מפיקים חשבונית בסכום שדורש הקצאה, המערכת שלנו פונה אוטומטית לרשות המיסים, מקבלת את מספר ההקצאה בתוך שבריר שנייה, ושותלת אותו על גבי החשבונית הדיגיטלית.
claims.source_note: SOURCE REPLACED 2026-08-10. The former URL (cardcom.solutions/blog/israel-invoices-complete-guide) still returns HTTP 200 but its body is now the SPA's "המאמר לא נמצא" article-not-found state, and both Wayback captures are the same empty SPA shell, so the old quote is unrecoverable. The claim was also over-broad: the setup steps and the pre-2025 threshold rows were never on a page we can still read, so they were split off (claims 27.1, 27.2) or removed from the body.

claims.claim: Allocation-number thresholds, on the pre-VAT transaction amount, per the Israel Tax Authority: 20,000 NIS / 20,000 ש"ח for 2025; 10,000 NIS / 10,000 ש"ח from 1 January 2026; 5,000 NIS / 5,000 ש"ח from 1 June 2026. The allocation number is a precondition for the buyer to deduct input VAT.
claims.raw_snippet: מספרי הקצאה אלה יידרשו כתנאי לניכוי מס התשומות בעסקאות שמעל לתקרה שנקבעה בחוק (20,000 ₪ לשנת 2025) 10,000 החל מה-1 בינואר 2026 ו-5,000 ₪ החל מה-1 ביוני 2026.
claims.source_note: Israel Tax Authority service page, footer states דף זה עודכן לאחרונה בתאריך 01.06.2026. The page also states the model applies from 1.1.2024 but gives no figure for 2024, so the former 25,000 (2024) table row was dropped from the skill body rather than left uncited.

claims.claim: Requesting an allocation number is done by the osek murshe (individual or corporation) or by anyone they authorised in the Tax Authority digital-actions authorisation system, so the permission has to be granted there once before the automated flow works.
claims.raw_snippet: עוסקים מורשים (יחידים ותאגידים) וכל מי שקיבלו מהם הרשאה במערכת למתן הרשאה לביצוע פעולות דיגיטליות.
